_about: The category types and values the browser suite names. Every display name and description is asserted by a test (the *CategoryTests fixtures assert each link's text and each type's description verbatim), so a mismatch fails a test rather than hiding in the fixture. Slugs are derived from the names; the tests locate categories by link text, never by url, so a slug only has to agree with the links the site generates from it. Casing is preserved as the tests assert it: Business area values in Title Case, the other types in sentence case. 'Not categorised' is a filter for products carrying no value of a type, not a stored value, and is deliberately absent. Every record must be published and enabled, because the site filters on both and an unpublished or disabled record is invisible exactly as a missing one is. The CMS defines no taxonomy in schema or seed; this file is the only definition.
